_comment: REPAIR, NOT A GATE (owner, 2026-09-07: a Broken Terminal should be used for crafting
terminals rather than removed). It is a SECOND route to a terminal, beside the plain
one, and that is deliberate: the market is the only source of knowledge, so making the
find a required ingredient would put a 1-in-16 roll on the critical path of the whole
progression spine. That is the deadlock #390 removed, arriving in a new shape - the
entry to the economy cannot sit behind a die roll any more than behind the economy.
So the chassis you found replaces the six Scrap Metal of the plain recipe, and the
parts that say WHICH terminal it becomes are the ones the plain recipe already uses to
tell them apart. Cheaper than building one, and the find now has a use that is not the
teardown - which remains, so it is a choice rather than a strictly better option.
